name: 02537 · East Sandwich, MA
findings: ZIP 02537 (East Sandwich) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02537 (East Sandwich) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
